## SocialDataX 敏感检测 MCP

Check text for sensitive words and potential content-policy risks using generic, Xiaohongshu, Douyin or Kuaishou rules; includes the account points-balance tool. This is a first-party SocialDataX integration to the SocialDataX hosted API; SocialDataX is independent of the social platforms whose data it provides. Use it to review a supplied draft for potential wording risks before publishing; the result is a review aid and does not guarantee platform acceptance. Configure your own `SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY` as `Authorization: Bearer <SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY>`; [API Key and setup](https://socialdatax.com/ai?from=toolhive), with business calls billed in SocialDataX credits. Public connection materials are MIT; the hosted service implementation is proprietary.
